item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 12/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring dry and cool weather to southern China today. Under the influence of replenishments of the monsoon and a rainband, it will be rather cool over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong in the latter part of this week. It will become cold appreciably over the region and the weather will improve during the weekend. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Pakhar will move in the general direction of the seas south of the Ryukyu Islands today and tomorrow.
